plans.idea: Classic product banner: a large bottle fills the left third at full height, and a left-aligned column on the right reads top to bottom as logo, big 'Glow' headline, then the Shop Now button, all sharing one left edge.

Mirrored editorial split: a message block on the left (logo, oversized headline, CTA stacked on one left edge) and the full-height bottle anchoring the right, so the copy is read first and the product closes the eye's path.

Centred three-part banner: brand and headline on the left, the bottle as the centrepiece, and the CTA on the right at the same height as the headline, so the strip reads left to right from brand to product to action.
